summary: Bhramanastra is a platform where we can examine and research about changes in the earths surface due to floods, storms, tsunami and other natural calamities. We took the challenge Dancing with the SARs in which our website provides valid data about the changes happening the surface of earth. It addresses the challenge by providing accurate information about the changes with solid reasons. It is important for us to look after the changes that happen in the planet we live in. One or the other we are also a cause for the changes that happen in the planet. We should take steps to protect it. Our first step is Bhramanastra.
details: Bhramanastra is a platform where we can study the changes happening on the surface of the earth. The user can draw rectangle, polygon or point option to check the variation or changes in that particular area. The platform will give valid and accurate information about the climate and other changes due to causes such as temperature, humidity and other factors. The benefits is that our platform is user friendly and the user can learn more easily in our platform. We provide valid detections on the earths surface and not false information. The Programming Languages inlcude: Python – Backend development, data processing, and scientific analysis, JavaScript – Frontend development and application functionality, HTML and CSS – Web interface structure and styling. Software and Development Tools includes: Visual Studio Code – Code editing and development, Antigravity – AI-assisted development and debugging, Git and GitHub – Version control and team collaboration, Vercel – Frontend deployment and hosting, Render – Backend deployment and hosting, OpenStreetMap – Map visualization and base map support. Our project provides a correct valid information pdf for more understanding of the problem. We considered the factors that affect the future. We select this topic as it need attention and solution.
